sources.purpose: Verify APAVIL recruitment signals against the operator's official hiring surface.

sources.purpose: Verify health-insurance and compensated-medicine signals against the official county insurance surface.
Verify signals about vacant school director and deputy-director positions against the dedicated official ISJ Vâlcea management surface.
Verify event-level fire and rescue signals against the official ISU Vâlcea local-news surface, complementing the official press-release feed.

sources.publisher: Administrația Bazinală de Apă Olt — SGA Vâlcea
sources.purpose: Verify Vâlcea water-management, water-quality and suspected pollution signals against the official ABA Olt / SGA Vâlcea public surface; never authorize publication without a material same-incident match.

Verify forestry, torrent-control, flood-risk and PNRR signals involving Vâlcea against official Romsilva press releases. A match must explicitly identify Vâlcea or a Vâlcea objective and preserve same-project identity; this target never authorizes publication by itself.

Verify Vâlcea free-sterilization campaign signals against the official event calendar of the veterinary campaign organizer. A match may verify only the locality, calendar date and time explicitly shown by the organizer; municipality sponsorship, venue, booking contacts, eligibility and medical instructions remain unverified unless they are present in first-party evidence. This target never authorizes publication by itself.

Verify press signals about current national-road traffic restrictions, closures or circulation conditions against the official INFOTRAFIC surface. This target may verify only the operational traffic state explicitly present in the current official notice; it never proves construction progress, project status, cause, duration beyond the stated window or publication eligibility.

Verify county-road works, closures and restriction signals against individually dated official CJ Vâlcea articles. Publication date is never operational status; a current restriction or works state must be explicit in same-item evidence and remains non-authorizing until the normal fact and editorial gates.
